title: Fan Cowl Door Hinge Beam Crack Repair by Splice Plate
abstract: Permanent splice plate repair of a crack in the fan cowl door hinge beam, with the coexistence rule against the stiffened beam standard and the door removal requirement.

sections.purpose: Permanent repair of a crack in the fan cowl door hinge beam by the installation of an internal splice plate across the cracked section, carried out with the door off the aircraft.
sections.damage_assessment: Cracks are found in the hinge beam web, usually at the aft hinge station and usually on a door with a high opening cycle count. The assessment must record the permanent set at the aft hinge station using the contour gauge before any repair, because a door that is distorted beyond the recorded limit is not repairable by this scheme and must be replaced. A door already carrying the stiffened beam standard is not repairable by this scheme either: the spar cap occupies the splice plate landing area and there is no room for both. That coexistence check is the first step of the assessment and is the one most often missed, because the spar cap is not visible with the outer panel in place.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the door from the nacelle and mount it in the door jig. Remove the outer panel in the repair area. Record the permanent set at the aft hinge station with the contour gauge. Confirm from the door identification plate and by inspection that the stiffened beam spar cap is not fitted. Remove the protective treatment from the repair area. Establish the crack extent by eddy current and stop-drill the crack tips. Position the splice plate across the cracked section as shown on repair drawing RD-54-10-12-002, using the intercostal stock D5410120303178 as the plate blank and the gusset D5410123630218 at the aft end. Drill the fastener pattern and install the fasteners wet. Re-restrain the drain line with new cable ties AES858082K2 clear of the splice plate. Restore the protective treatment and refit the outer panel.
sections.inspection_requirements: Eddy current inspection of the stop-drilled holes and the splice plate fastener rows after installation. A repeat eddy current inspection is required at every door removal, and in any case not more than 6 000 flight hours apart. The permanent set at the aft hinge station must be re-measured at every repeat inspection and recorded; a growing set indicates the repair is not carrying the load and the door must be assessed for replacement.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Cracks up to 40 mm in the hinge beam web, not entering the hinge fitting land, and only on a door without the stiffened beam spar cap.

repair_drawings.title: Internal splice plate, fan cowl door hinge beam

materials.description: INTERCOSTAL STOCK, USED AS SPLICE PLATE BLANK

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows, 18 fasteners each side of the crack, 20 mm pitch, 14 mm edge distance
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Not life limited, but the repair is re-inspected at every door removal and the permanent set is re-measured at each inspection.
